svg.text: AWS SAMPLES · AI AGENT FACTORY · MIT-0 · v1.0.0
Multi-account topology with D-01 distributed and D-03 centralised inference call paths — control plane at the top, data planes in the middle, audit and cost at the base

g.text: default distributed path · per-workload LiteLLM · AgenticAI-<app>-nonprod / -prod
3 AZs · PRIVATE_ISOLATED · no IGW / no NAT · 11 VPCEs + S3 gateway · SG pair · Flow Logs (CMK)
Gateway stays with Runtime — only inference and platform governance cross account boundaries
centralised AI platform services · registries · central guardrail

svg.text: every InvokeModel / Converse / …Stream MUST supply bedrock:GuardrailIdentifier — GATE 1 SCP-02 (org) · GATE 2 IAM task role (account) · GATE 3 Bedrock VPCE (network)

g.text: execution role scoped to LiteLLM + ECR + CWL
metrics · logs · traces linked to the audit sink
alias ARN · Cedar · owner · cost centre
trusted by the CDK Pipelines role
tags: app · agent · tenant · account · cost-centre · env
Source → Synth → Deploy(non-prod) → Eval Gate → Approval → Canary → Prod
AgentCore Runtime invokes the per-workload LiteLLM Gateway over HTTPS (internal ALB).
LiteLLM calls the Bedrock Runtime VPCE — InvokeModel / Converse with GuardrailIdentifier required.
VPCE reaches Amazon Bedrock over PrivateLink; baseline guardrail applied, invocation logged.
Workload runtime assumes BedrockCallerRole in the platform account (ExternalId, no TagSession).
Platform role calls Converse with modelId = the per-tenant Application Inference Profile ARN.
Profile resolves to the foundation model; central guardrail + logging apply, tags drive the CUR.

svg.text: 500 Jest tests / 50 suites (240 conformance) · 31 pytest integration + 7 teardown · 12/12 live-verified on real AWS, re-verified 2026-07-02 · synth clean against AwsSolutionsChecks + NIST80053R5Checks · 24 security exceptions registered
Account IDs (123456789012, 444444444444, …) are scrubber-safe placeholders — real AWS account IDs are never embedded. scripts/scp-sandbox-soak.sh is untested live; Titan V2 embeddings deferred.
